data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Pigmentary & cosmeceutical agents_

**Class:** Botanical cosmeceutical (Glycyrrhiza glabra)

## Mechanism of action
- Glabridin inhibits tyrosinase and is anti-inflammatory; liquiritin disperses melanin

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Melasma, PIH, sensitive skin/rosacea (anti-inflammatory) — cosmeceutical creams

## Dose & formulations
- Creams with licorice extract once or twice daily

## Adverse effects
- Rare irritation

## Contraindications
- Allergy

## Pregnancy & lactation
Topical acceptable.

## Viva points
- Glabridin — tyrosinase inhibitor; liquiritin — melanin dispersion

_Sources: Khopkar ch.26 and ch.29 (Cosmeceuticals). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
